key.name: toggle-popup
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the popup

key.name: super-key-opens-popup
key.summary: Open the popup with the Super key instead of the overview
key.description: Pressing Super twice quickly opens the overview. The Activities button and hot corner still open the overview.

key.name: open-on-primary-monitor
key.summary: Always open the launcher on the primary display
key.description: Otherwise it opens on the display with the mouse pointer.

key.name: backdrop-transparency
key.summary: Transparency of the backdrop behind the popup, in percent

key.name: vertical-position
key.summary: Vertical position of the launcher, in percent
key.description: 0 puts it at the top of the screen, 100 as low as it fits with search results showing.

key.name: search-min-width
key.summary: Minimum width of the search results, in pixels
key.description: The panel widens to this while showing results. It never gets wider than the screen.

key.name: dash-icon-scale
key.summary: Size of the dash icons, in percent of their normal size

key.name: dash-at-bottom
key.summary: Show the dash at the bottom of the screen
key.description: Instead of attached below the search panel.

key.name: enable-path-search
key.description: Search text starting with /, ~ or file:// offers to open the path or show it in Files, suggests matching entries, and completes with Tab.

key.name: enable-run-command
key.description: Search text starting with “run ” offers to run the rest as a command. Failures are shown as a notification.

key.name: enable-web-search
key.description: Search text starting with “web ” offers to search the rest with the default browser’s search engine.

key.name: web-search-url
key.summary: Search page for browsers without a search command line
key.description: Used when the default browser isn’t Firefox or Chromium based. %s is replaced by the search terms.

key.name: show-preview
key.summary: Show the launcher as a preview
key.description: Shows the launcher without taking input while its settings are changed. Turned off again when the settings window closes and when the extension is enabled.
